notes.title: Khuga Bash! Release!
notes.notes:
Attention Basher!

We are thrilled to announce that Khuga Bash! is now available on Steam! Dive into the action-packed world of Khugaverse, where you'll join Kuro on an epic journey through the formidable Paw Lab.

Khuga Bash! is a combat game that challenges your skills and strategy as you help Kuro survive a series of intense battles. Overcome obstacles, defeat powerful opponents, and prove your prowess to become the ultimate champion of Khugaverse.

Key Features:

🥊 Battle Ferocious Bosses: Go toe-to-toe with ferocious bosses as you venture deeper into the heart of the Khugaverse. Can you out-punch them all?

🏆 Fight for Supremacy: Climb the leaderboards, rack up the highest scores, and make your mark as the reigning Khuga combat champion!

👊 Intense Combat: Engage in adrenaline-pumping combat with lightning-fast action, powerful combos, and a range of combat styles to master.

🌐 Explore the Arena: Immerse yourself in the dynamic Khuga arena, each battle more intense and challenging than the last.

And to celebrate our release day we giving 15% discount until 7 days! So wait no more and start to bash!
